text:
Jordan P: Hey folks — quick question: vendor event last week (client dinner) was paid on vendor's invoice to us, but vendor also submitted an invoice to charge food + VAT. Do we reimburse them? How do we code the expense and can we reclaim VAT? Need to close month.

Elaine (People Ops): @Jordan P did vendor submit a VAT invoice to Redwood or to the client? If it's to Redwood we can potentially reclaim if we have VAT reg in that country.

Jordan P: It was billed to Redwood (they sent an invoice to finance). The vendor used 'entertainment' line and included VAT 20%.

Trevor (Finance): If billed to Redwood -> treat as supplier invoice, not an expense report. Put it through AP. Code: EXP:CLIENT_ENT. VAT: capture tax amount on VAT recovery report. We reclaim if vendor VAT is valid and the expense is business entertainment which may be non-deductible in some countries — policy: entertainment VAT reclaim varies.

Amira: Quick operational Q: vendor also included itemized receipts for meals; do we need guest lists for client entertainment?

Elaine (People Ops): Yes require guest list & business purpose. For client entertainment include client company name, attendees, and relationship to business. Use template: 
```
Date: 2026-02-14
Client: Acme Corp
Attendees: Jordan P (Redwood), Sam R (Acme), Vendor rep
Purpose: Product demo + dinner follow-up
```

Trevor (Finance): Also need vendor invoice with tax registration number and VAT breakdown. If missing, we can't reclaim VAT; then code net+tax as AP expense. If vendor asks us to reimburse via employee expense (they paid personally) — we don't reimburse vendor via expense report; use AP only.

Jordan P: Got it. Vendor already sent invoice to AP. Anything else to avoid delays?

Trevor (Finance): Add project tag (PRJ-452) and attach guest list + PDF invoice in Concur (or AP portal). If amount > 1,000 EUR need manager approval.

Elaine (People Ops): Note for perks policy: when entertaining clients, tax treatment differs — if the meal includes alcohol we still accept but note in comment. Keep receipts scanned.

expense-bot: Reminder: New supplier invoices must be created in AP system within 5 business days of receipt. Link: https://intranet.redwood/ap

Jordan P: Thanks all — I'll upload docs today. :thumbsup:
